name: EU Generalized Scheme of Preferences (GSP)
key_benefits: Reduced or zero tariff rates for eligible Indian exports, particularly textiles, apparel, and leather products.
origin_criteria: Products must be wholly obtained or sufficiently worked or processed in India.

specific_regulations.textiles: Indian textiles face an average reduced tariff of 9.6% under the GSP standard arrangement compared to higher standard MFN rates. Exporters must comply with REACH regulations for chemicals used.
specific_regulations.general: Products must bear the CE mark requirements to demonstrate compliance with EU safety, health, and environmental protection standards.
